info.title: Gravix API
info.description: HTTP observability platform — ingestion and gateway APIs

post.description: Submit an array of RequestFact events for ingestion. Validated, buffered, and stored as JSONL.
Submit an array of ServiceEvent records.
Create a new tenant, admin user, and optionally a Stripe customer.
Validate credentials and return a JWT token. If 2FA is enabled, requires totp_code or recovery_code.
Revoke the current JWT by adding its JTI to the blacklist.
Send a password reset email. Always returns 200 to prevent email enumeration.

200.description: Reset email sent if address is registered

post.description: Reset password using a valid token from the reset email.

get.description: Verify a user's email using the token from the verification email. Also accepts POST with JSON body.

api_key.description: Initial API key (only on first verification)

post.description: Resend the email verification link for the authenticated user.

put.description: Change the authenticated user's password by providing current and new passwords.

post.description: Exchange a valid JWT for a fresh one with a new expiry. Revokes the old token.

201.description: API key created (plaintext key returned only once)

403.description: Admin role required or email not verified

delete.description: Revoke an API key by its ID.

404.description: Key not found or already revoked

get.description: Returns API keys expiring within the next 7 days.

post.description: Processes Stripe webhook events. Authenticated via Stripe-Signature header, not JWT.

get.description: Returns Stripe invoice history for the tenant.
Returns monthly usage summaries for up to 12 months.

post.description: Send a test message through the specified notification channel.

put.description: Partial update of an alert rule. Only provided fields are changed.

get.description: Returns paginated alert firing history. Optionally filter by rule_id.
Proxy analytics queries to Cube.js for dashboard rendering.
Returns recent trace summaries grouped by trace ID.
Returns all spans for a specific trace.
Returns recent DLQ entries for the tenant.

post.description: Re-submit DLQ entries to the ingestion endpoint. Validates tenant ownership.

get.description: Returns paginated audit entries for the tenant. Admin only.
Returns the tenant's data retention settings and plan limits.

put.description: Set custom retention periods (within plan limits). Use 0 for plan default.

post.description: Stream a tar.gz archive of raw JSONL files for a date range. Max 30 days, 1 concurrent export per tenant.

get.description: List pending team invitations for the tenant.

post.description: Invite a user to join the tenant. Admin only. Enforces seat limits.

403.description: Admin role required or seat limit reached

post.description: Accept an invitation and create a user account. No JWT required.

get.description: Returns all users in the tenant (password hashes excluded).

put.description: Change a user's role or status. Admin only. Cannot modify yourself.

get.description: Returns all personal data held for the authenticated user (GDPR Article 15).
Download personal data as a JSON file (GDPR Article 20).
Returns all consent records for the authenticated user.

post.description: Record a new consent decision (tos, privacy, or cookies).

delete.description: Schedule the tenant for deletion with a 30-day grace period. Admin only.

post.description: Cancel a pending account deletion request. Admin only.
Generate a TOTP secret and provisioning URL for authenticator apps.
Verify the TOTP code to enable 2FA. Returns recovery codes.

400.description: Invalid TOTP code or setup not started

post.description: Disable 2FA by providing a valid TOTP code.

400.description: Invalid TOTP code or 2FA not enabled

get.description: Returns current SSO configuration for the tenant (secrets redacted).

put.description: Create or update SSO settings. Admin only. Requires business plan or higher.

403.description: Admin role required or plan too low

delete.description: Remove SSO settings for the tenant. Admin only.

get.description: Start the SSO authentication flow for a tenant. Returns a redirect URL.

post.description: Process SSO provider callback, provision user via JIT, and return a JWT.

get.description: Returns all active sessions for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Revoke a specific session by ID or all sessions (?id=all).

get.description: Returns child organizations for multi-org tenants. Admin only.

post.description: Create a child org under the current tenant. Requires scale or enterprise plan.

403.description: Admin role required or plan too low

get.description: Returns referral codes created by the tenant.

post.description: Generate a new referral code for the tenant.
Apply a referral code. Both parties receive 1 month free.
Submit in-app user feedback. Logged to audit trail for product team review.

get.description: Returns 200 if the service process is running.
Returns 200 with component status if the service is ready to handle traffic.

path_template.description: URL path with {id} placeholders, no query params

requires_2fa.description: True when 2FA code is needed to complete login
